comment: A repository's own API records (docs/19-your-own-apis.md) and what reading and validating them must report. Both engines are held to these exact messages: OwnKnowledgeTest.java and web/tests/unit/own.test.ts. The base is the knowledge/ directory of this repository.

cases.name: a valid record with a literal rule and no manifest

files..docswatcher/providers/internal-billing/:
provider: internal-billing
literals:
  - id: internal-billing.literal.endpoint
    kind: endpoint
    files: ["**/*.py"]
    pattern: 'billing\.acme\.dev(/v[0-9]+/[a-z]+)'
    key: "ANY $1"

id: internal-billing-v1-sunset
provider: internal-billing
kind: sunset
severity: breaking
title: Billing v1 is switched off
summary: Use v2.
affects:
  - kind: endpoint
    match: "ANY /v1/invoices"
announced: 2026-09-01
effective: 2027-01-31
sources:
  - kind: changelog
    url: https://docs.acme.dev/billing/changelog
    observed: 2026-09-01
migration:
  replacement: "ANY /v2/invoices"
  guide: https://docs.acme.dev/billing/v2
  effort: small
status: active

cases.name: detector rules

files..docswatcher/providers/internal-search/d:
provider: internal-search
manifests:
  - ecosystem: cargo
    package: search-client
literals:
  - id: stripe.literal.endpoint
    kind: endpoint
    files: ["**/*"]
    pattern: 'a'
    key: "x"
  - id: internal-search.literal.bad
    kind: query
    confidence: certain
    files: []
    pattern: 'a*+b(?<=c)'
callsites:
  - id: internal-search.py.find
    language: python
    kind: sdk_method
    requires: search-sdk
    query: '(call function: (attribute attribute: (identifier) @m) (#eq? @m "find")) @call'
    key: "Search.find"

errors: internal-search.literal.bad: files must not be empty
internal-search.literal.bad: pattern lookbehind is not allowed
internal-search.py.find: requires search-sdk which is not a manifest rule of internal-search
stripe.literal.endpoint: detector id must start with internal-search.
